title: Technical and source-rights certifications
extraction_rule: Boolean flags are encoded explicitly 1=true,0=false solely for chart display; they are not performance scores. Preserve source boolean as additional value.

study_context.window: 2015-01-01 through 2026-06-05; frozen knowledge cutoff 2026-06-09; repair vintage 2026-08-12
study_context.universe: complete observed clean price panel, not a strategy sample
study_context.instrument: cash price bridge between adjusted and exact frozen raw observations
study_context.execution: data-only validation; exact-session gaps remain explicit and fold handling fail-closed
study_context.inference: deterministic validity/linkage checks; no market-return inference

caveats: Technical certification and source-rights certification are independent.
Source-rights status is the archived governance decision for these rows; no present-day legal assessment is made.
Exact raw linkage proves origin, not automation, retention or derived-use permission.
Invalid/absent marks remain fail-closed. Zero invalid observed bridges does not mean zero missing exact-session observations.
No strategy performance, Sharpe, CAGR or P&L was computed.
